findings: CVE-2025-54267 is a real, still-PUBLISHED CWE-863 privilege-escalation in Magento Login as Customer: an ACL-gated admin can persist a login_as_customer row, log in a customer via secret, and that impersonated session remains authorized by row presence after Magento_LoginAsCustomer::login is revoked or the admin is reassigned.
The smallest surviving public first-writer is dd15e184efe63d3fa5ebdf6d7906ef5874b5fdf2. Its verified parent 2c4dbba9111184299cba2935b26b23011566ee65 contains only README.md.
The 2020 subdirectory import 57b8afd0826576bd0e086d1c00628f2d606afb47 and later namespace/module-split/logout-invalidation commits are reconstructable carriers or partial controls, not the BIC.

Direct fix 485febbd60a1eb28da779024c6c27f856e28ed39 adds the missing role/user revocation hooks. Six core fix blobs are byte-identical in vendor-designated Magento Open Source tags 2.4.9-alpha3, 2.4.8-p3, 2.4.7-p8, and 2.4.6-p13 and absent from the corresponding affected predecessors.
